name: Internet Accessible Device
summary: Adversaries may gain access into industrial environments through systems exposed directly to the internet for remote access rather than through External Remote Services. Internet Accessible Devices are exposed to the internet unintentionally or intentionally without adequate protections. This may allow for adversaries to move directly into the control system network. Access onto these devices is accomplished without the use of exploits, these…

analytics.name: Analytic 1928
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies inbound connections to Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows application servers from internet-routed Internet Protocol (IP) addresses. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2253
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) device or server accepting an inbound connection on its native protocol port from a source Internet Protocol (IP) address outside the organization's address space. Documented in Trend Micro's manufacturing honeypot research, with adversaries exploiting exposed Siemens S7, Omron Factory Interface Network Service (FINS), EtherNet/IP, and misconfigured Virtual Network Computing (VNC).
